import numpy as np
from scipy import linalg
import warnings

# Test 1: 3x3 singular matrix
try:
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter('always')
        A1 = np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])
        result1 = linalg.sqrtm(A1)
        
        # Record the result
        probe("np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])", result1)
        
        # Record whether a warning was raised and what it was
        if len(w) > 0:
            probe("np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])::warning_raised", True)
            probe("np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])::warning_category", w[0].category.__name__)
            probe("np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])::warning_message", str(w[0].message))
        else:
            probe("np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])::warning_raised", False)
            probe("np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])::warning_category", None)
            probe("np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])::warning_message", None)
        
        # Record whether inf appears in result[0, 1:] (the problematic entries)
        probe("np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])::has_inf_in_0_1", np.isinf(result1[0, 1]))
        probe("np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])::has_inf_in_0_2", np.isinf(result1[0, 2]))
        
except Exception as e:
    probe("np.array([[0, 2, 2], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]])", "__error__: " + type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e))

# Test 2: 2x2 singular matrix
try:
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter('always')
        A2 = np.array([[0, 1], [0, 0]])
        result2 = linalg.sqrtm(A2)
        
        # Record the result
        probe("np.array([[0, 1], [0, 0]])", result2)
        
        # Record whether a warning was raised and what it was
        if len(w) > 0:
            probe("np.array([[0, 1], [0, 0]])::warning_raised", True)
            probe("np.array([[0, 1], [0, 0]])::warning_category", w[0].category.__name__)
            probe("np.array([[0, 1], [0, 0]])::warning_message", str(w[0].message))
        else:
            probe("np.array([[0, 1], [0, 0]])::warning_raised", False)
            probe("np.array([[0, 1], [0, 0]])::warning_category", None)
            probe("np.array([[0, 1], [0, 0]])::warning_message", None)
        
        # Record whether inf appears in result[0, 1]
        probe("np.array([[0, 1], [0, 0]])::has_inf_in_0_1", np.isinf(result2[0, 1]))
        
except Exception as e:
    probe("np.array([[0, 1], [0, 0]])", "__error__: " + type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e))
